Your Mechs each have [ASSAULT]. (+1 while we're attackers.)
When I conquer, you may recycle another friendly unit to play a Mech from your trash. Reduce its Energy cost by the Might of the unit you recycled.

cards.name: Rumble, Hotheaded (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
Your Mechs each have [ASSAULT]. (+1 while we're attackers.)
When I conquer, you may recycle another friendly unit to play a Mech from your trash. Reduce its Energy cost by the Might of the unit you recycled.

cards.name: Dunebreaker
cards.description:
If you have two or fewer cards in your hand, I enter ready.
When I hold, draw 2.
cards.flavorText: Dunes don't break like branches. They break like waves.

cards.name: Lucian, Gunslinger
cards.description:
[ASSAULT] (+1 Might while I'm an attacker.)
When I attack, deal damage equal to my [ASSAULT] to an enemy unit here.
cards.flavorText: "Everybody dies. Some just need a little help."

cards.name: Lucian, Gunslinger (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
[ASSAULT] (+1 Might while I'm an attacker.)
When I attack, deal damage equal to my [ASSAULT] to an enemy unit here.
cards.flavorText: "Everybody dies. Some just need a little help."

cards.name: Rek'Sai, Breacher
cards.description:
[ACCELERATE] (You may pay 1 Fury as an additional cost to have me enter ready.)
[ASSAULT] (+1 Might while I'm an attacker.)
Friendly units played from anywhere other than a player's hand have [ACCELERATE].

cards.name: Rek'Sai, Breacher (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
[ACCELERATE] (You may pay 1 Fury as an additional cost to have me enter ready.)
[ASSAULT] (+1 Might while I'm an attacker.)
Friendly units played from anywhere other than a player's hand have [ACCELERATE].

cards.name: Skyfall of Areion
cards.description:
[EQUIP 1, Fury] (1, Fury: Attach this to a unit you control.)
My hold effects are also conquer effects, and vice verse.
Might +2

cards.name: Desert's Call
cards.description:
[REPEAT 2] (You may pay the additional cost to repeat this spell's effect)
Play a 2 Might Sand Soldier unit token.
cards.flavorText: The Great Sai desert hides as many spears as it does secrets.

cards.name: Disarming Rake
cards.description: When you play me, you may kill a gear.
cards.flavorText: "I like to break things: swords, arms, hearts..."

cards.name: Doran's Shield
cards.description:
[EQUIP Calm] (Calm: Attach this to a unit you control.)
TANK (I must be assigned combat damage first.) +1 Might

cards.name: Feral Strength
cards.description:
REACTION (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
[REPEAT 2] (You may pay the additional cost to repeat this spell's effect.)
Give a unit +2 Might this turn.

cards.name: Guardian of the Passage
cards.description: When I hold, you may return a unit or gear from your trash to your hand.
cards.flavorText: In the Shadow Isles, the veil between life and death is thin indeed.

cards.name: Lonely Poro
cards.description: [DEATHKNELL] — If I died alone, draw 1. (When I die, get the effect. I'm alone if there are no other friendly units here.)
cards.flavorText:
Far from fluft and all alone
None to mourn but ice and stone
—Ode to a Lonely Poro

cards.name: Navori Scout
cards.description: [DEFLECT] (Opponents must pay Rune to choose me with a spell or ability.)
cards.flavorText: The Navori Brotherhood has neither a height requirement nor a retirement age.

cards.name: Ribbon Dancer
cards.description: When I move to a battlefield, give another friendly unit +1 Might this turn.
cards.flavorText: A flutter of silk is all the warning her enemies get.

cards.name: Royal Entourage
cards.description: When you play me, ready or exhaust a legend.
cards.flavorText: After the seat of the ancient Shuriman Empire rose from the sands and its immortal emperor stepped out of myth to lead it, those who first embraced his rule were richly rewarded.

cards.name: Thwonk!
cards.description:
[ACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
[REPEAT] (You may pay the additional cost to repeat this spell's effect.)
Stun an attacking unit. (It doesn't deal combat damage this turn.)

cards.name: Apprentice Smith
cards.description: When I move, reveal the top card of your Main Deck. If it's a gear, draw it. Otherwise, recycle it.
cards.flavorText: "My mentor says every failed project is a lesson. Me, I use 'em as paperweights."

cards.name: Brutalizer
cards.description:
[EQUIP Calm] (Calm: Attach this to a unit you control.)
If this was attached to me this turn, I have an additional +2 Might.
+1 Might.

cards.name: Emperor's Divide
cards.description:
[HIDDEN] (Hide for now Rune to react with later for 0.)
[ACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
Move any number of friendly units at a battlefield on their base.
cards.flavorText: The sands of battle shift of Azir's command.

cards.name: Legion Quartermaster
cards.description: As an additional cost to play me, return a friendly gear to its owner's hand.
cards.flavorText: "An ancient runeblade! Very rare. Take it to Tent 3 for processing."

cards.name: Not So Fast
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
Counter an enemy spell or ability that chooses a friendly unit or gear.

cards.name: Poro Snax
cards.description:
When you play this, draw 1.
1 Calm, Exhaust, Kill this: Draw 1.
cards.flavorText:
"Eat, eat and grow strong!."
—Braum

cards.name: Simian Ancestor
cards.description: When you buff me, ready me.
cards.flavorText: "I'm faster than I look. Older too, if you can believe it."

cards.name: Stellacorn Herder
cards.description: When I move, draw 1.
cards.flavorText: "Finding lost stellacorns is easy! It's catching them that's the hard part."

cards.name: Aphelios, Exalted
cards.description:
When you attach an Equipment to me, choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn ‚Äî
‚Ä¢Ready 2 runes.
‚Ä¢Channel 1 rune exhausted.
‚Ä¢Buff a friendly unit.

cards.name: Azir, Ascendant
cards.description: Calm: [ACTION] ‚Äî Choose a unit you control. Move me to its location and it to my original location. If it's equipped, you may attach one of its Equipment to me. Use only once per turn.
cards.flavorText: "Challenge Shurima, challenge fate."

cards.name: Azir, Ascendant (Alternate Art)
cards.description: Calm: [ACTION] ‚Äî Choose a unit you control. Move me to its location and it to my original location. If it's equipped, you may attach one of its Equipment to me. Use only once per turn.
cards.flavorText: "Challenge Shurima, challenge fate."

cards.name: Guardian Angel
cards.description:
[EQUIP Calm] (Calm: Attach this to a unit you control.)
If I would die, kill Guardian Angel instead. Heal me, Exhaust me, and recall me.
Might +1

cards.name: Heart of Dark Ice
cards.description: Exhaust: Give a unit +3 Might this turn.
cards.flavorText:
"All will knee...in time."
—Lissandra

cards.name: Janna, Savior
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve, including to a battlefield you control.)
When you play me, heal your units here, then move an enemy unit from here to its base.
cards.flavorText: "Gale winds unleashed!"

cards.name: Jax, Unmatched
cards.description:
[DEFLECT] (Opponents must pay 1 Rune to choose me with a spell or ability.)
Each Equipment in your hand has [QUICK-DRAW]. (It gains [REACTION]. When you play it, attach it to a unit you control.)
cards.flavorText: "Fighting Words! My favorite kind."

cards.name: Jax, Unmatched (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
[DEFLECT] (Opponents must pay 1 Rune to choose me with a spell or ability.)
Each Equipment in your hand has [QUICK-DRAW]. (It gains [REACTION]. When you play it, attach it to a unit you control.)
cards.flavorText: "Fighting Words! My favorite kind."

cards.name: Needlessly Large Yordle
cards.description:
[SHIELD 5] (+5 Might while I'm a defender.)
[TANK] (I must be assigned combat damage first.)
I cost 2 and 1 Calm less for each point you scored from holding this turn.
cards.flavorText: How did a yordle get so big? You're welcome to ask him.

cards.name: Sterak's Gage
cards.description:
[QUICK-DRAW] (This has REACTION. When you play it, attach it to a unit you control.)
[EQUIP Calm] (Calm: Attach this to a unit you control.)
Might +3
cards.flavorText: Claws for concern.

cards.name: Irelia, Fervent
cards.description:
DEFLECT (Opponents must pay Rune to choose me with a spell or ability)
When you choose or ready me, give me +1 Might this turn.
cards.flavorText: "Do we want to be safe, or free? The choice is ours."

cards.name: Irelia, Fervent (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
DEFLECT (Opponents must pay Rune to choose me with a spell or ability)
When you choose or ready me, give me +1 Might this turn.
cards.flavorText: "Do we want to be safe, or free? The choice is ours."

cards.name: Ornn, Blacksmith
cards.description: When you play me or when I hold, look at the top 4 cards of your Main Deck. You may reveal a gear from among them and draw it. Then recycle the rest.
cards.flavorText: "Gods do not need followers. Followers need gods."

cards.name: Ornn, Blacksmith (Alternate Art)
cards.description: When you play me or when I hold, look at the top 4 cards of your Main Deck. You may reveal a gear from among them and draw it. Then recycle the rest.
cards.flavorText: "Gods do not need followers. Followers need gods."

cards.name: Svellsongur
cards.description:
[EQUIP1, Calm] (1, Calm: Attach this to a unit you control.)
As this is attached to a unit, copy that unit's text to this Equipment's effect text for as long as this is attached to it.
Might +0
cards.flavorText: "Only the greatest Freljord heroes have weapons made of True Ice!" — Nunu

cards.name: Tianna Crownguard
cards.description:
[DEFLECT] (Opponents must pay 1 Rune to choose me with a spell or ability.)
While I'm at a battlefield, opponents can't score points.
cards.flavorText: "I will stand for my country, my family, and nothing else."

cards.name: Aspiring Engineer
cards.description: When you play me, return a gear from your trash to your hand.
cards.flavorText: "Before you know it, I'll be running this place."

cards.name: Bubble Bot
cards.description: When you play me, ready another friendly Mech.
cards.flavorText: The first Bubble Bot started as a practical joke in the scrapyard, but the Mark II soon replaced the morning wake-up bell.

cards.name: Chemtech Cask
cards.description: When you play a spell on an opponent's turn, you may exhaust me to play a Gold gear token exhausted.
cards.flavorText:
"Piltover coos over perfumes while Zaun struggles to breathe."
—Renata Glasc

cards.name: Cloth Armor
cards.description:
[QUICK-DRAW] (This has [REACTION]. When you play it, attach it to a unit you control.)
[EQUIP Mind] (Mind: Attach this to a unit you control.)
[SHIELD 2] (+2 Might while I'm a defender.)
Might +2

cards.name: Forecaster
cards.description: Your Mechs have [VISION]. (When you play us, look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.)
cards.flavorText: A good mech pilot has quick reflexes. A great one doesn't need them.

cards.name: Frigid Touch
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
[REPEAT 2] (You may pay the additional cost to repeat this spell's effect.)
Give a unit -2 Might this turn.
cards.flavorText: "Freeze."

cards.name: Frostcoat Cub
cards.description:
You may pay Mind as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, give a unit -2 Might this turn.
cards.flavorText: In the Freljord, cuteness is just another survival tactic.

cards.name: Gearhead
cards.description:
[ACCELERATE] (You may pay 1 and Mind as an additional cost to have me enter ready.)
Each Equipment attached to me gives double its base Might bonus.
cards.flavorText: "Some people dream about the future. I'm living it."

cards.name: Plundering Poro
cards.description: When I conquer, play a Gold gear token exhausted.
cards.flavorText: Piracy is the universal language.

cards.name: Wages of Pain
cards.description:
[HIDDEN] (Hide now for 1 Rune to react with later for 0.)
[ACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
Deal 3 to a unit at a battlefield. Play a Gold gear token exhausted.
cards.flavorText: Smash AND grab.

cards.name: Breakneck Mech
cards.description:
Your Mechs have [DEFLECT] and [GANKING]. (Opponents must pay 1 Rune to choose us with a spell or ability. We can move from battlefield to battlefield.)
I enter ready if you control another Mech.

cards.name: Dropboarder
cards.description: When you play me, if you control two or more gear, ready me.
cards.flavorText: Piltover prides itself on progress, but the Firelights prove that Zaun is no less inventive.

cards.name: Experimental Hexplate
cards.description:
[EQUIP Calm] (Calm: Attach this to a unit you control.)
I am a mech.
+1 Might

cards.name: Pickpocket
cards.description: When you play me, you may kill a gear with Energy cost no more than 1. If you do, play a Gold gear token exhausted.
cards.flavorText:
"Sticky fingers never linger."
—Pickpockets' motto

cards.name: Prize of Progress
cards.description: When you use an activated ability of a gear, give me +1 Might this turn.
cards.flavorText: In Piltover's Progress Day parade, even the floats are groundbreaking innovations.

cards.name: Production Surge
cards.description:
This costs 2 less if you control a Mech.
Play a 3 Might Mech unit token to your base.
Draw 1.
cards.flavorText: When in doubt, make more mechs.

cards.name: Rocket Barrage
cards.description:
[REPEAT 4 Mind] (You may pay the additional cost to repeat this spell's effect, and may make different choices.)
Choose one —
• Deal 4 to a unit in a base.
• Kill a gear.

cards.name: Temporal Portal
cards.description: 1 Rune, Exhaust: Give the next spell you play this turn [REPEAT] equal to its cost. (You may pay the additional cost to repeat the spell's effect.)
cards.flavorText: Those who study history get to choose whether they'll repeat it.

cards.name: Bard, Mercurial
cards.description:
You may exhaust your legend as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, move any number of your units to an open battlefield.
cards.flavorText: (Mysterious chiming noises intensify.)

cards.name: Bellows Breath
cards.description:
[ACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
[REPEAT 1, Mind] (You may pay the additional cost to repeat this spell's effect.)
Deal 1 to up to three units at the same location.
cards.flavorText: "My work speaks in the roar of flame and the ringing of steel."—Ornn

cards.name: Card Sharp
cards.description: When you play me, you and each opponent may play a Gold gear token exhausted. For each opponent who did, you play a Gold gear token exhausted.
cards.flavorText: "Call."

cards.name: Ezreal, Dashing
cards.description:
When I attack or defend, deal damage equal to my Might to an enemy unit here.
I don't deal combat damage.
Mind: [ACTION] ‚Äî Move me to your base.
cards.flavorText: "Time for a true display of skill."

cards.name: Ezreal, Dashing (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
When I attack or defend, deal damage equal to my Might to an enemy unit here.
I don't deal combat damage.
Mind: [ACTION] ‚Äî Move me to your base.
cards.flavorText: "Time for a true display of skill."

cards.name: Hextech Anomaly
cards.description: Exhaust: [REACTION] — Pay any amount of Runes to [ADD] that much Energy. (Abilities that add resources can't be reacted to.)
cards.flavorText: "Hextech promises to transform the present. But progress must not come at the future's expense!"— Heimerdinger

cards.name: Jayce, Man of Progress
cards.description: When you play me, you may kill a friendly gear. If you do, you may play a gear with Energy cost no more than 7 from hand this turn, ignoring its Energy cost. (You must still pay its Power cost.)
cards.flavorText: "This is what the future looks like."

cards.name: Ornn, Forge God
cards.description:
[DEFLECT 2] (Opponents must pay 2 Runes to choose me with a spell or ability.) [WEAPONMASTER] (When you play me, you may [EQUIP] one of your Equipment to me for 1 Rune less, even if it's already attached.)
I have +1 Might for each friendly gear.

cards.name: Ornn, Forge God (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
[DEFLECT 2] (Opponents must pay 2 Runes to choose me with a spell or ability.) [WEAPONMASTER] (When you play me, you may [EQUIP] one of your Equipment to me for 1 Rune less, even if it's already attached.)
I have +1 Might for each friendly gear.

cards.name: World Atlas
cards.description:
[EQUIP Mind] (Mind: Attach this to a unit you control.)
When I hold, play two Gold gear tokens exhausted. +2 Might

cards.name: Premonition
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
Draw 3.
cards.flavorText: Wisdom through power, power through wisdom.

cards.name: Renata Glasc, Mastermind
cards.description:
1, Mind: Draw 1.
1,4 Mind, Exhaust: Score 1 point.
Use my abilities only while I'm at a battlefield.
cards.flavorText: "Progress comes at a price others aren't willing to pay."

cards.name: Renata Glasc, Mastermind (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
1, Mind: Draw 1.
1,4 Mind, Exhaust: Score 1 point.
Use my abilities only while I'm at a battlefield.
cards.flavorText: "Progress comes at a price others aren't willing to pay."

cards.name: Rumble, Scrapper
cards.description:
Your Mechs have +1 Might (including me).
When I hold, play a 3 Might Mech unit token to your base.
cards.flavorText: "Ever look up to a yordle?"

cards.name: Rumble, Scrapper (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
Your Mechs have +1 Might (including me).
When I hold, play a 3 Might Mech unit token to your base.
cards.flavorText: "Ever look up to a yordle?"

cards.name: The Zero Drive
cards.description:
[EQUIP 1, Calm] (1, Calm: Attach this to a unit you control.)
3, Calm, Banish this: Play all units banished with this, ignoring their costs. (Use only if unattached.)
[DEATHKNELL] — Banish me. (When I die, get the effect.)
Might +2

cards.name: Buhru Captain
cards.description: When you play me, you may draw 1 or buff me. (To buff a unit, give it a +1 Might buff if it doesn't already have one.)
cards.flavorText: "The Buhru knew these waters long before the flotsam of Bilgewater washed up on our shores. We know them still."

cards.name: Combat Chef
cards.description: [WEAPONMASTER] (When you play me, you may [EQUIP] One of your Equipment to me for Rune less, even if it's already attached.)
cards.flavorText: "The tastiest soup is the one you eat after almost getting your head chopped off."

cards.name: Dauntless Vanguard
cards.description: You may play me to an occupied enemy battlefield.
cards.flavorText: When the Demacian Elite receive an order, their commander considers the mission complete.

cards.name: Direwing
cards.description: I enter ready if you control another Dragon.
cards.flavorText: A dragon's definition of "prey" is all inclusive.

cards.name: Doran's Blade
cards.description:
[EQUIP Body] (Body: Attach this to a unit you control.)
+2 Might
cards.flavorText:
"I guess I could...throw it at someone
—Miss Fortune"

cards.name: Laurent Bladekeeper
cards.description: [GANKING] (I can move from battlefield to battlefield.)
cards.flavorText: "This old dog has plenty of tricks already."

cards.name: Punch First
cards.description:
[ACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
Give a unit +5 Might this turn.
cards.flavorText: It's not for the inquisitive.

cards.name: Sea Monkey
cards.description:
You may pay 1 as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, buff me. (Give me a +1 Might Buff if I don't already have one.)
cards.flavorText:
"Do, monkey."
—Nilah

cards.name: Veteran Poro
cards.description: [WEAPONMASTER] <em>(When you play me, you may [EQUIP] one of your Equipment to me for Rune less, even if it's already attached.)
cards.flavorText:
Train hard, little poro, and one day you will be strong."
—Braum

cards.name: Yordle Explorer
cards.description: When you play a card with Power cost 2 Runes or more, draw 1.
cards.flavorText: "We can't stop yet! We're just getting started!"

cards.name: Fae Dragon
cards.description:
When you play me, buff up to four friendly units. (Give each one a +1 Might buff if it doesn't have one.)
When you spend a buff, play a Gold gear token exhausted.
cards.flavorText: The fae who guard the boundary of the spirit realm take their job as seriously as they take anything.

cards.name: Hexdrinker
cards.description:
[EQUIP Body] (Body: Attach this to a unit you control.)
[DEFLECT] (Opponents must pay Rune to choose me with a spell or ability.) +1 Might

cards.name: Jaull-Fish
cards.description:
[ACCELERATE] (You may pay 1 Body as an additional cost to have me enter ready.)
I cost 2 less for each of your [MIGHTY] units. A unit is Mighty while it has 5+ Might.)
cards.flavorText: It's not hungry. It's not territorial. It just really hates boats.

cards.name: Petricite Monument
cards.description:
[TEMPORARY] (Kill this at the start of its controller's Beginning Phase, before scoring.)
Friendly units have [DEFLECT]. (Opponents must pay Rune to choose them with a spell or ability.)
cards.flavorText: Monuments of magic-absorbing petricite serve both to protect the Kingdom of Demacia and to celebrate it.

cards.name: Ruin Runner
cards.description: I can't be chosen by enemy spells and abilities.
cards.flavorText: "Catch me if you can."

cards.name: Show of Strength
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
Draw 1 for each of your [MIGHTY] units. (A unit is Mighty while it has 5+ Might)
cards.flavorText: Strength in numbers.

cards.name: Strike Down
cards.description: Choose an equipped friendly unit. It deals damage equal to its Might to an enemy unit. Then detach an Equipment from it.
cards.flavorText: "Is that all it takes?"

cards.name: Warmog's Armor
cards.description:
[EQUIP Body] (Body: Attach this to a unit you control.)
When I conquer, buff me. (If I don't have a buff, I get a +1 Might buff.)+1 Might

cards.name: Akshan, Mischievous
cards.description:
[WEAPONMASTER]
You may pay Body Body as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, move an enemy gear to your base. You control it until I leave the board. If it's an Equipment, attach it to me.

cards.name: Fiora, Peerless
cards.description: When I attack or defend one on one, double my Might this combat.
cards.flavorText: "I have no equal."

cards.name: Fiora, Peerless (Alternate Art)
cards.description: When I attack or defend one on one, double my Might this combat.
cards.flavorText: "I have no equal."

cards.name: Here to Help
cards.description:
[HIDDEN] (Hide now for Rune to react with later for 0.)
[ACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
You may play a unit from hand to a battlefield you control, reducing its cost by 3.

cards.name: Kato the Arm
cards.description:
[DEFLECT] (Opponents must pay Rune to choose me with a spell or ability.)
When I move to a battlefield, give a friendly unit my keywords and +Might equal to my Might this turn.
cards.flavorText: "Let's give "em a good show!."

cards.name: Lucian, Merciless
cards.description:
[WEAPONMASTER] (When you play me, you may [Equip] one of your Equipment to me for 1 Rune less, even if it's already attached.)
The first time I conquer each turn, ready me.
cards.flavorText: <em>"One of us finds peace. One of us walks away."</e>

cards.name: Lucian, Merciless (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
[WEAPONMASTER] (When you play me, you may [EQUIP] one of your Equipment to me for 1 Rune less, even if it's already attached.)
The first time I conquer each turn, ready me.
cards.flavorText: <em>"One of us finds peace. One of us walks away."</e>

cards.name: Marching Orders
cards.description:
[ACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
[REPEAT 3] (You may pay the additional cost to repeat this spell's effect.)
Choose a friendly unit anywhere and an enemy unit at a battlefield. They deal damage equal to their Mights to each other.

cards.name: Trinity Force
cards.description:
[EQUIP Body] (Body: Attach this to a unit you control.)
When I hold, score 1 point. +2 Might

cards.name: Yone, Blademaster
cards.description:
[WEAPONMASTER] (When you play me, you may [EQUIP] one of your Equipment to me for Rune less, even if it's already attached.)
When I conquer an open battlefield, deal damage equal to my Might to an enemy unit in a base.

cards.name: Ancient Henge
cards.description: Exhaust: [REACTION] — Pay any amount of Energy to [ADD] that much Rune. (Abilities that add resources can't be reacted to.)
cards.flavorText: "It's not enough to protect a pile of ice and stone. We must protect each other, and build a community on the foundations our ancestors left us." —Ashe

cards.name: Boneshiver
cards.description:
[EQUIP 1 Body] (1 Body: Attach this to a unit you control.)
When I conquer, channel 1 rune exhausted. Might +2.

cards.name: Jax, Unrelenting
cards.description:
[WEAPONMASTER] (When you play me, you may [Equip] one of your Equipment to me for 1 Rune less, even if it's already attached.)
When you attach an Equipment to me, you may pay 1 to draw 1.

cards.name: Jax, Unrelenting (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
[WEAPONMASTER] (When you play me, you may [Equip] one of your Equipment to me for 1 Rune less, even if it's already attached.)
When you attach an Equipment to me, you may pay 1 to draw 1.

cards.name: Sivir, Ambitious
cards.description:
[DEFLECT 2] (Opponents must pay to choose me with a spell or Ability.)
When I conquer after an attack, if you assigned 5 or more excess damage to enemy units, you may deal that much to an enemy unit.
cards.flavorText: "Honor is the rust on a dull blade."

cards.name: Sivir, Ambitious (Alternate Art)

[DEFLECT 2] (Opponents must pay to choose me with a spell or Ability.)
When I conquer after an attack, if you assigned 5 or more excess damage to enemy units, you may deal that much to an enemy unit.
cards.flavorText: "Honor is the rust on a dull blade."

cards.name: Black Market Broker
cards.description: When you play a card from face down, play a gold gear token exhausted.
cards.flavorText: "Top of the line. Never used. And no pesky licenses to worry about."

cards.name: Called Shot
cards.description:
[ACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
[REPEAT Chaos] (You may pay the additional cost to repeat this spell's effect.)
Look at the top 2 cards of your Main Deck. Draw one and recycle the other.

cards.name: Corrupt Enforcer
cards.description:

[DEATHKNELL] Repeat this gear's play effect. (When this dies, get the effect.)

cards.name: Diana, Lunari
cards.description: When a showdown begins here, you may pay 1. If you do, PREDICT, then reveal the top card of your Main Deck. If it's a spell, draw it. (To Predict, look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.)
cards.flavorText: "Follow no false light."

cards.name: Diana, Lunari (Alternate Art)
cards.description: When a showdown begins here, you may pay 1. If you do, PREDICT, then reveal the top card of your Main Deck. If it's a spell, draw it.
cards.flavorText: "Follow no false light."

cards.name: Hwei, Brooding Painter
cards.description:
When I move, draw 1, then discard 1. Then, do the following based on the discarded card's type:
‚Ä¢ Spell - Draw 1.
‚Ä¢ Gear - Ready up to 2 runes.
‚Ä¢ Unit - Give me +3 Might this turn.

cards.name: Keeper of Masks
cards.description:
[HIDDEN] (Hide now for 1 Rune to react with later for 0.)
[TEMPORARY] (Kill me at the start of my controller's Beginning Phase, before scoring.)
When you play me, play two Reflection unit tokens here. They become copies of me.

cards.name: Lillia, Fae Fawn
cards.description:
[ACCELERATE] (You may pay 1 + 1 Calm as an additional cost to have me enter ready.)
When I move from a location, play a 3 Might Sprite unit token with [TEMPORARY] there. (Kill it at the start of its controller's Beginning Phase, before scoring.)

cards.name: Lillia, Fae Fawn (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
[ACCELERATE]
When I move from a location, play a 3 Might Sprite unit token with [TEMPORARY] there.

cards.name: Smoke and Mirrors
cards.description:
[Hidden] (Hide now for 1 Rune to react with later for 0.)
[ACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
Choose a unit you control and another unit you control at a different location. If at least one of them has [TEMPORARY], move each to the other's location. Draw 1.

cards.name: Sprite Queen
cards.description: When you play me or at the start of your Beginning Phase, play a ready 3 Might Sprite unit token with [TEMPORARY] to your base. (Kill them at the start of their controller's next Beginning Phase, before scoring.)

cards.name: Sumpworks Map
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
[TEMPORARY] (Kill this at the start of its controller's Beginning Phase, before scoring.)
When an opponent scores, draw 1.
cards.flavorText: "Hang on, it's upside-down."

cards.name: Zilean, Time Mage
cards.description: Once each turn, if you would play a token unit while I'm at a battlefield, you may play that token and an additional copy of it instead.
cards.flavorText: "I feel like I've done this before."

cards.name: Blue Sentinel
cards.description:
SHIELD 2 (+2 Might while I'm a defender.)
Your hold effects for holding here trigger an additional time.
When I hold, Add 1 Rune at the start of your next Main Phase. (Abilities that add resources can't be reacted to.)

cards.name: Blue Sentinel (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
SHIELD 2
Your hold effects for holding here trigger an additional time.
When I hold, Add 1 Rune at the start of your next Main Phase.

cards.name: Gutter Palace
cards.description:
At the start of your Beginning Phase, if you have exactly 4 cards in hand and 4 units at battlefields, you win the game.
Discard 1, Exhaust: Play a 1 Might Bird unit token with DEFLECT. (Opponents must pay 1 Rune to choose it with a spell or ability.)

cards.name: Jhin, Meticulous Killer
cards.description:
[VISION] (When you play me, look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.)
If you've spent 4 or more to play a spell this turn, you may play me for 1 Mind.
cards.flavorText: "One, two, three, four. Two, two, three, four..."

cards.name: Jhin, Meticulous Killer (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
[VISION]
If you've spent 4 or more to play a spell this turn, you may play me for 1 Mind.
cards.flavorText: "One, two, three, four. Two, two, three, four..."

cards.name: LeBlanc, Everywhere At Once
cards.description:
[BACKLINE] (I must be assigned combat damage last.)
Your [TEMPORARY] effects at my battlefield don't trigger.
cards.flavorText: "Vision. Might. Guile. It's almost comical how history repeats itself."

cards.name: LeBlanc, Everywhere At Once (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
[BACKLINE]
Your [TEMPORARY] effects at my battlefield don't trigger.
cards.flavorText: "Vision. Might. Guile. It's almost comical how history repeats itself."

cards.name: Concentrate
cards.description:
Draw 2.
[LEVEL 6] This costs 2 less. (While you have 6+ XP, get the effect.)
[LEVEL 11] This costs 4 less instead.
cards.flavorText:
"Peace within, peace without."
—Master Yi

cards.name: Demacian Diplomat
cards.description: When you play me, gain 1 XP.
cards.flavorText: After decades in the Demacian diplomatic corps, he's found dozens of polite ways to say "leave us alone."

cards.name: Dragonsoul Sage
cards.description: [REACTION] Exhaust: Add 1. (Abilities that add resources can't be responded to.)
cards.flavorText: "The Dragon's secrets are not mine to share. I can only share the gifts that it has given me."

cards.name: Gemhand Hunter
cards.description:
[HUNT] (When I conquer or hold, gain 1 XP.)
[LEVEL 6] I have +1 Might. (While you have 6+ XP, get the effect.)
cards.flavorText: He's a yordle of many facets.

cards.name: Grim Resolve
cards.description:
[ACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
Give a friendly unit +3 Might this turn. When it wins a combat this turn, gain 2 XP.
cards.flavorText: "If you think losing is the best teacher, you should really give winning a try."

cards.name: Hunter's Machete
cards.description:
[EQUIP 1 BODY] (1 Body: Attach this to a unit you control.)
[HUNT] (When I conquer or hold, gain 1 XP.)

cards.name: Kinkou Initiate
cards.description: When you play me, draw 1 if your other units have total Might 5 or more
cards.flavorText: True strength lifts up others.

cards.name: Targonian Visionary
cards.description: [LEVEL 11] I have +4 Might.(While you have 11+ XP, get the effect.)
cards.flavorText: She has seen the world before. She will see that world again.

cards.name: Towering Combatant
cards.description:
[SHIELD 2] (+2 Might while I'm a defender.)
[TANK] (I must be assigned combat damage first.)
cards.flavorText: "Was this really your plan, pal?"

cards.name: Voracious Gromp
cards.description: [HUNT 3] (When I conquer or hold, gain 3 XP.)
cards.flavorText: "Oh no! It's real! The Gromp is real!"

cards.name: Call to Battle
cards.description: Move a unit you control to a battlefield you control. Then, choose an opponent. They move a unit they control to the same battlefield.
cards.flavorText: "I said, what're you gonna do about it?!"

cards.name: Crowd Favorite
cards.description:
[HUNT] (When I conquer or hold, gain 1 XP.)
Spend 2 XP: [BUFF] me. (Give me a +1 Might buff if I don't have one.)
cards.flavorText: "The crowd is a beast like any other. Hear it roar?"

cards.name: Disposal Order
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
Choose one —
• Choose up to 3 cards from opponents' trashes. Their owners recycle them.
• Draw 1.
cards.flavorText: "Get it cleaned up by sunrise. No questions."

cards.name: Gentle Gemdragon
cards.description: When you play me or another Dragon, ready up to 2 runes.
cards.flavorText: "Gentle" is not the same as "harmless."

cards.name: Imposing Challenger
cards.description: When I move, you may move an enemy unit here with less Might than me to a different battlefield.
cards.flavorText: "Are there truly none with the courage to face our new champion?"

cards.name: Repulse
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
Choose a friendly unit at a battlefield. Counter an enemy spell or ability that chooses it and no other friendly unit.

cards.name: Stare Down
cards.description: Choose a friendly unit and a battlefield. Move all enemy units at that battlefield with less Might than the chosen unit to their base. Gain 1 XP.
cards.flavorText: The eyes have it.

cards.name: Wily Newtfish
cards.description: If you've gained XP this turn, I have +1 Might and [GANKING]. I can move from battlefield to battlefield.)
cards.flavorText: Half newt, half fish. All nuisance.

cards.name: Blood Rose
cards.description:
When you play a unit, you may pay 1 to gain 1 XP.
Spend 3 XP, Exhaust: Ready a unit.
cards.flavorText: Anything to get the blood pumping.

cards.name: Clash of Giants
cards.description: Choose two units. They deal damage equal to their Mights to each other.
cards.flavorText:
"The land slumbers, but it is not dead. With my roar, I wake it. With my thunder, I call it."
—Volibear

cards.name: Determined Sentry
cards.description: I can't move to base.
cards.flavorText: Discretion has nothing on valor.

cards.name: Irresistible Faefolk
cards.description: Choose two units. They deal damage equal to their Mights to each other.
cards.flavorText: Cute, yes. Cuddly, no.

cards.name: Master Yi, Tempered
cards.description:
HUNT 2 (When I conquer or hold, gain 2 XP.)
LEVEL 6 I have DEFLECT and GANKING. (While you have 6+ XP, opponent must play 1 Rune to choose me with a spell or ability and I can move from battlefield to battlefield.)
cards.flavorText: "Watch, and learn."

cards.name: Master Yi, Tempered (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
HUNT 2
LEVEL 6 I have DEFLECT and GANKING.
cards.flavorText: "Watch, and learn."

cards.name: Nidalee, Cat Form
cards.description:
[AMBUSH] (You may play me as a [REACTION] to a battlefield where you have units.)
When I win a combat, draw 1. (I win if I remain after combat.)
cards.flavorText: "Meow! Ahem...Anyway."

cards.name: Nilah, Joyful Ascetic
cards.description:
[ACCELERATE] (You may pay 1 + 1 Body as an additional cost to have me enter ready.)
[GANKING] (I can move from battlefield to battlefield.)
When I move, gain 1 XP.
cards.flavorText: "All I feel is joy! It is... difficult."

cards.name: Poppy, Paragon
cards.description:
[DEFLECT] (Opponents must pay 1 Rune to choose me with a spell or ability.)
When you play me, if an opponent's score is within 3 points of the Victory Score, ready me and gain 3 XP.
cards.flavorText: "Me? The hero? Nah, that's ridiculous."

cards.name: Poppy, Paragon (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
[DEFLECT] (Opponents must pay 1 Rune to choose me with a spell or ability.)
When you play me, if an opponent's score is within 3 points of the Victory Score, ready me and gain 3 XP.
cards.flavorText: "Me? The hero? Nah, that's ridiculous."

cards.name: Arachnoid Horror
cards.description:
[HUNT 2] (When I conquer or hold, gain 2 XP.)
I can be played to an occupied battlefield if an enemy unit is alone there.
Friendly units can be played to an occupied battlefield if an enemy unit is alone there.
cards.flavorText: Don't go alone.

cards.name: Elder Dragon
cards.description:
Any amount of your damage is enough to kill enemy units.
When you play me, choose up to one enemy unit at each location. Deal 1 to them.
cards.flavorText: Clearing the dragons out of the mountain just made room for a bigger dragon.

cards.name: Elder Dragon (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
Any amount of your damage is enough to kill enemy units.
When you play me, choose up to one enemy unit at each location. Deal 1 to them.
cards.flavorText: Clearing the dragons out of the mountain just made room for a bigger dragon.

cards.name: Kha'Zix, Evolving Hunter
cards.description:
HUNT (When I conquer or hold, gain 1 XP.)
When I attack, you may spend 3 XP to deal damage equal to my Might to an enemy unit here.
cards.flavorText: "Consume and adapt."

cards.name: Kha'Zix, Evolving Hunter (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
HUNT (When I conquer or hold, gain 1 XP.)
When I attack, you may spend 3 XP to deal damage equal to my Might to an enemy unit here.
cards.flavorText: "Consume and adapt."

cards.name: Rengar, Trophy Hunter
cards.description:
[AMBUSH] (You may play me as a [REACTION] to a battlefield where you have units.)
I can be played to a battlefield where there are enemy units (even if you don't have units there).
cards.flavorText: "Let's see what they're made of."

cards.name: Rengar, Trophy Hunter (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
[AMBUSH]
I can be played to a battlefield where there are enemy units.
cards.flavorText: "Let's see what they're made of."

cards.name: Bewitching Spirit
cards.description: When you play me, choose a player. They discard 1.
cards.flavorText: Bandle Scout Rule 43: When a mysterious voice in the woods whispers for you to follow it, don't go alone! Your friends might want to see too!

cards.name: Crescent Guardian
cards.description: If you've played a spell this turn, you may pay 1 Chaos as an additional cost to play me. If you do, I enter ready.
cards.flavorText: The Lunari have few allies among Targon's mortal denizens, but that doesn't mean they're alone.

cards.name: Evershade Stalker
cards.description: When you play me, discard 1, then draw 1.
cards.flavorText:
"That's a LOT of eyes."
—Common last words

cards.name: Isolate
cards.description: Move an enemy unit from a battlefield to its base. Then, if there's an enemy unit alone at that battlefield, draw 1.
cards.flavorText:
"Hey, where is everyone?"
—Common last words

cards.name: Lunar Boon
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
Discard 1, then draw 2.
cards.flavorText:
"A new moon is rising."
—Diana

cards.name: Megatusk
cards.description: Spend 3 XP. Give your units here [GANKING] this turn. (We can move from battlefield to battlefield.)
cards.flavorText:
Q: What do you do if there's a megatusk in your boat?
A: Buy a new boat.

cards.name: Mister Root
cards.description:
[ACCELERATE] (You may pay 1 and 1 Chaos as an additional cost to have me enter ready.)
When I move to a battlefield, gain 2 XP.
cards.flavorText: Dreams themselves can dream as well.

cards.name: Star-Crossed
cards.description:
REACTION (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
Return a friendly unit and an enemy unit to their owners' hands.
cards.flavorText: <em>"I've made my preparations. Meet me on the ridge at midnight, and we'll go."— Unsigned note

cards.name: Vicious Snapjaws
cards.description: When another friendly unit dies, gain 1 XP.
cards.flavorText: They don't know friend or foe, only food.

cards.name: Walking Roost
cards.description:
DEFLECT (Opponents must pay 1 Rune to choose me with a spell or ability.)
When you play me, choose an opponent. They play a 1 Might Bird unit token with DEFLECT.
cards.flavorText: They have to leave the nest eventually.

cards.name: Abandon
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
Counter a spell. Return it to its owner's hand instead of putting it in their trash.
[PREDICT]. (Look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.)

cards.name: Angler Beast
cards.description: When you play me, return all units with 2 Might or less to their owners' hands.
cards.flavorText:
"There's plenty of room for everyone at the bottom of the sea."
—Pyke

cards.name: Blast Cone
cards.description:
When you play this, you may move an enemy unit.
When you move an enemy unit, you may exhaust this to [STUN] it. (It doesn't deal combat damage this turn.)
cards.flavorText: Seeds of destruction.

cards.name: Existential Dread
cards.description:
[ACTION] Play this on your turn or in showdowns.)
[REPEAT 2] (You may pay the additional cost to repeat this spell's effect.)
[STUN] an attacking unit. If it's already stunned, return it to its owner's hand instead. (A stunned unit doesn't deal combat damage this turn.)

cards.name: Insightful Investigator
cards.description: When you play me, choose an opponent. They reveal their hand. You may pay 2 XP to choose a card from their hand. If you do, they discard that card and draw 1.

cards.name: Scryer's Bloom
cards.description:
This enters exhausted.
Kill this, 1, Exhaust: [PREDICT 2], then draw 1. Gain 1 XP. (To Predict 2, look at the top two cards of your Main Deck. Recycle any of them and put the rest back in any order.)
cards.flavorText: Not all foliage conceals.

cards.name: Sinister Poro
cards.description: When I attack, you may pay 1 to move an enemy unit here to its base.
cards.flavorText: Are you going to be the one to tell him he's not scary?

cards.name: The List
cards.description:
As you play this, name a tag. (For example, Miss Fortune, Demacia, and Poro are tags.)
Exhaust: Give a unit with the named tag -2 Might this turn.
cards.flavorText: There are some lists you don't want to be on.

cards.name: Bone Skewer
cards.description:
[HIDDEN] (Hide now for 1 Rune to react with later for 0.)
Choose a battlefield. An opponent reveals their hand. You may choose a unit from it. They play that unit to that battlefield, ignoring any and all costs. When they do, [STUN] it. (It doesn't deal combat damage this turn.)

cards.name: Conscription
cards.description:
You may spend 5 XP as an additional cost to play this.
Choose an enemy unit at a battlefield with 3 Might or less. If you paid the additional cost, choose any enemy unit at a battlefield instead. Take control of it, exhaust it, and recall it.

cards.name: Evelynn, Entrancing
cards.description:
[HIDDEN] (Hide now for 1 Rune to react with later for 0.)
[BACKLINE] (I must be assigned combat damage last.)
When you play me from face down on your turn, you may move an enemy unit at a different location to my battlefield.
cards.flavorText: "Girls just wanna tear your throat out with their teeth."

cards.name: Heedless Resurrection
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
As an additional cost to play this, kill a friendly unit.
Play a unit from your trash that costs no more Energy and no more Power than the killed unit, ignoring its cost.

cards.name: Kha'Zix, Mutating Horror
cards.description:
[AMBUSH] (You may play me as a [REACTION] to a battlefield where you have units.)
When I attack or defend, if an enemy unit is alone here, give me +2 Might this turn and gain 2 XP.
cards.flavorText: "I sense worthy prey."

cards.name: Kha'Zix, Mutating Horror (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
[AMBUSH]
When I attack or defend, if an enemy unit is alone here, give me +2 Might this turn and gain 2 XP.
cards.flavorText: "I sense worthy prey."

cards.name: Maduli the Gatekeeper
cards.description:
I can't be readied.
1 Chaos: Move me to an occupied enemy battlefield if my Might is greater than the total Might of enemy units there.
cards.flavorText:
"... Made a song so eerie, thought I'd die."
—Old Gaff's tale

cards.name: Pyke, Returned
cards.description:
HIDDEN (Hide now for 1 Rune to react with later for 0.)
BACKLINE (I must be assigned combat damage last.)
Once each turn, when an enemy unit dies while I'm at a battlefield, play a Gold gear token exhausted. (It has "REACTION Kill this, Exhaust: Add 1 Rune.")

cards.name: Pyke, Returned (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
HIDDEN
BACKLINE
Once each turn, when an enemy unit dies while I'm at a battlefield, play a Gold gear token exhausted.

cards.name: Syndra, Transcendent
cards.description: While I'm in a showdown, your spells have [REPEAT 2 + 1 Chaos]. (You may pay the additional cost to repeat the spell's effect.)
cards.flavorText: "This power is mine to command."

cards.name: Baron Nashor
cards.description:
As you play me, add the Baron Pit battlefield token to the board if it's not there already. If you do, I enter there. (It has "Units can move here from anywhere.")
I can't be chosen by enemy spells and abilities.
Other friendly units have +2 Might.

cards.name: Baron Nashor (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
As you play me, add the Baron Pit battlefield token to the board if it's not there already. If you do, I enter there. (It has "Units can move here from anywhere.")
I can't be chosen by enemy spells and abilities.
Other friendly units have +2 Might.

cards.name: Cursed Sarcophagus
cards.description:
When you play this, banish all units from your trash.
Exhaust: Play a unit banished with this. (You must pay its costs.)
cards.flavorText:
"Do not disturb."
—Sarcophagus inscription

cards.name: Diana, No Longer Human
cards.description:
[AMBUSH] (You may play me as a [REACTION] to a battlefield where you have units.)
When you play a spell, give me +2 Might this turn.
cards.flavorText: "I cannot turn back."

cards.name: Diana, No Longer Human (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
[AMBUSH]
When you play a spell, give me +2 Might this turn.
cards.flavorText: "I cannot turn back."

cards.name: Vex, Apathetic
cards.description:
[DEFLECT] (Opponents must pay 1 Rune to choose me with a spell or ability.)
When an opponent plays a unit while I'm at a battlefield, [STUN] it. They can't move it this turn. (It doesn't deal combat damage this turn.)
cards.flavorText: "I'll show them the meaning of apathy. Or not."

cards.name: Vex, Apathetic (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
[DEFLECT]
When an opponent plays a unit while I'm at a battlefield, [STUN] it. They can't move it this turn.
cards.flavorText: "I'll show them the meaning of apathy. Or not."

cards.name: Bandle Soldier
cards.description: [LEVEL 3] I enter ready. (While you have 3+ XP, get the effect.)
cards.flavorText: Bandle Scout Rule 170: Everything makes you better at everything.

cards.name: Black Rose Dignitary
cards.description:
[ASSAULT] (+1 Might while I'm attacking.)
[DEATHKNELL] Channel 1 rune exhausted.(When I die, get the effect.)
cards.flavorText: The beauty of the petals hides the sting of the thorns.

cards.name: Carrion Dredger
cards.description: [DEATHKNELL] Play a 1 Might Bird unit token with [DEFLECT] to your base. (When I die, get the effect. Opponents must pay 1 Rune to choose a [DEFLECT] unit with a spell or ability.)
cards.flavorText: The automaton paused and stared in wonder. Amidst the detritus sat a single unbroken egg.

cards.name: Crimson Pigeons
cards.description: I have +2 Might while I'm attacking with another unit.
cards.flavorText: They deliver a message.

cards.name: Heroic Charge
cards.description:
[ACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
Give a friendly unit +1 Might this turn and [STUN] an enemy unit at its location. (A stunned unit doesn't deal combat damage this turn.)
cards.flavorText:
"Sometimes you just gotta do it yourself."
—Poppy

cards.name: Loyal Poro
cards.description: DEATHKNELL If I didn't die alone, draw 1. (When I die, get the effect. I wasn't alone if there were other friendly units here.)
cards.flavorText: A head full of bravery and not much else.

cards.name: Scrutinizing Sergeant
cards.description: When you play me, gain 1 XP for each friendly unit.
cards.flavorText: "Hmmmm ..."

cards.name: Shepherd's Heirloom
cards.description:
When you play this, gain 1 XP.
[EQUIP] — Spend 1 XP (Pay the cost: Attach this to a unit you control.)
cards.flavorText: "Even the sheep can tell it's special. And sheep aren't very smart."

cards.name: Soul Harvest
cards.description: Kill a unit at a battlefield with 3 Might or less.
cards.flavorText: It won't hurt a bit—it'll hurt a LOT.

cards.name: Ultrasoft Poro
cards.description: Exhaust: Play two 1 Might Bird unit tokens with DEFLECT. Use this ability only while I'm at a battlefield. (Opponents must pay 1 Rune to choose a DEFLECT unit with a spell or ability.)
cards.flavorText: How? Magic. And conditioner.

cards.name: Divining Shells
cards.description:
[VISION] (When you play this, look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.)
[ACTION] Kill this, Exhaust, Give a unit +2 Might this turn.
cards.flavorText: Today's treasure is tomorrow's trash.

cards.name: Enthralling Protector
cards.description:
[HUNT] (When I conquer or hold, gain 1 XP.)
Spend 2 XP: [BUFF] me. (Give me a +1 Might buff if I don't have one.)
cards.flavorText: Irresistible force indeed.

cards.name: Mageseeker Investigator
cards.description: Opponents must pay 1 Rune for each unit beyond the first to move multiple units to my battlefield at the same time.
cards.flavorText: "State your name and business."

cards.name: Safety Inspector
cards.description:
You may spend 3 XP as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, each player must kill one of their units. If you paid my additional cost, you don't kill a unit this way.
cards.flavorText: "Looks fine to me!"

cards.name: Shadow's Call
cards.description: Choose a friendly unit without [TEMPORARY]. Give it [TEMPORARY]. Draw 2. (Kill it at the start of its controller's Beginning Phase, before scoring.)
cards.flavorText: "You're a disappointment. A failure. Why fight it?"

cards.name: Stalking Wolf
cards.description:
AMBUSH (You may play me as a REACTION to a battlefield where you have units.)
As an additional cost to play me, kill a Bird, Cat, Dog, or Poro you control. You may play me to its battlefield (even if you don't have other units there).
cards.flavorText: Nature does not seek forgiveness.

cards.name: Starhound
cards.description: When you play me, return a Bird, Cat, Dog, or Poro from your trash to your hand.
cards.flavorText: It guards to flock, no matter where they stray.

cards.name: Undying Loyalty
cards.description:
This costs 2 less if you choose a Bird, Cat, Dog, or Poro.
Play a unit with cost no more than 2 and no more than 1 Rune from your trash, ignoring its cost.
cards.flavorText: "We would call them all back, if we could."

cards.name: Ashe, Focused
cards.description: When you play me, choose an opponent. They reveal their hand. Choose a card revealed this way and banish it. When they hold, return it to their hand (even if I'm no longer on the board).
cards.flavorText: "No fate is written, except by us."

cards.name: Atakhan
cards.description:
You may kill a friendly unit as an additional cost to play me. If you do, I cost 1 less for each Energy it costs and 1 Order less for each Power it costs.
[GANKING] (I can move from battlefield to battlefield.)
When I attack, the defender must kill one of their units here.

cards.name: Galio, Indefatigable
cards.description:
[DEFLECT] (Opponents must pay 1 Rune to choose me with a spell or ability.)
[TANK] (I must be assigned combat damage first.)
I don't deal combat damage.
cards.flavorText: "Hahahaha! Did we win yet?"

cards.name: LeBlanc, Fragmented
cards.description:
[ASSAULT] (+1 Might while I'm an attacker.)
[DEATKNELL] Draw 1. If it's your Beginning Phase, draw 2 instead. (When I die, get the effect.)
cards.flavorText: "My greatest strength is that there are so many of us..."

cards.name: LeBlanc, Fragmented (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
[ASSAULT]
[DEATKNELL] Draw 1. If it's your Beginning Phase, draw 2 instead.

I can't be chosen by enemy spells and abilities unless I'm in combat.
When I move to a battlefield, give me +2 Might this turn.
cards.flavorText: "Skill and steel will get the job done."

cards.name: Crumbling Sands
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
Counter a spell if an opponent has played another spell this turn.
cards.flavorText: Time will reduce all greed to dust.

cards.name: Decree of Focus
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
Choose a friendly unit that's in combat with an enemy Fury (Fury) unit or that's being chosen by an enemy Fury spell. Give it +4 Might this turn.
cards.flavorText: Rage is a quagmire. Tread lightly.

cards.name: Riven, Shattered
cards.description:
[WEAPONMASTER] (When you play me, you may [EQUIP] one of your Equipment to me for Rune less, even if it's already attached.)
When I attack, choose an enemy unit here. Deal 2 to it for each Equipment attached to me.
cards.flavorText: "A sword mirrors its owner."

cards.name: Shen, Scourge of Shadows
cards.description: When I hold, if there is exactly one other unit you control here, draw 1.
cards.flavorText: "Our wills align."

cards.name: Shen, Scourge of Shadows (Alternate Art)
cards.description: When I hold, if there is exactly one other unit you control here, draw 1.
cards.flavorText: "Our wills align."

cards.name: Steel Paws
cards.description:
[DEFLECT] (Opponents must pay Rune to choose me with a spell or ability.)
[EMPOWER 7] (7: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] I have +7 Might.
cards.flavorText: When the rats get too big, it's time to innovate.

cards.name: Astral Heron
cards.description: When you play your first card each turn, if I'm at a battlefield, your next card costs 2 and 2 Runes less.
cards.flavorText: With its flight, the night falls.

cards.name: Helm of Suppression
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 4 and 1 Calm] (4 and 1 Calm: Empower this. Use only if not Empowered.)
Opponents' spells cost 1 more. If this is [EMPOWERED], they cost 1 and 1 Rune more instead.
cards.flavorText: "Are we having fun yet?"

cards.name: Nasus, Ascended
cards.description:
[DEFLECT 2] (Opponents must pay 2 Runes to choose me with a spell or ability.)
[EMPOWER 8] (8: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] When I conquer, you score 1 point.
cards.flavorText: "Eternity is beyond your reach."

cards.name: Nasus, Ascended (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
[DEFLECT 2]
[EMPOWER 8]
[EMPOWERED] When I conquer, you score 1 point.
cards.flavorText: "Eternity is beyond your reach."

cards.name: Apprentice Mage
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 2] (2: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
When I become [EMPOWERED], [Predict 2]. (Look at the top 2 cards of your Main Deck. Recycle any of them and put the rest back in any order.)
[EMPOWERED] I have +1 Might.

cards.name: Cloud Drake
cards.description: When you play me, draw 1.
cards.flavorText: <em>These things are a cirrus problem.<em>

cards.name: Dredge Up
cards.description:
Draw 1.
[FLOW 2] (You may play this from your trash for its Flow cost. Then banish it.)
cards.flavorText: By hook and for crook.

cards.name: Grumpy Rockbear
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 12]. This ability costs 1 less for each rune you control. (Pay the cost: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] I have [DEFLECT] and [SHIELD 3]. (Opponents must pay Rune to choose me with a spell or ability. +3 Might while I'm a defender.)

cards.name: Iterative Design
cards.description:
Play a 3 Might Mech unit token.
[FLOW 2 and 1 Mind] (You may play this from your trash for its Flow cost. Then banish it.)
cards.flavorText: It's not always a bad thing to reinvent the wheel.

cards.name: Mesmerize
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
Choose one —
• Return a friendly unit to its owner's hand.
• Give an enemy unit -2 Might this turn.
cards.flavorText: "Inaction invites regret." —Mel

cards.name: Otterpus
cards.description: If a player would score 1 point from conquering or holding during their first or second turn, they draw 1 instead.
cards.flavorText: Bandle Scout Rule 99: Make sure to keep all food out in the open. You never know who might want a snack!

cards.name: Questionable Tome
cards.description:
[EMPOWER] — Exhaust (Pay the cost: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
Disempower this, 1, Exhaust: Draw 1.
cards.flavorText: Or is it?

cards.name: Applied Researchers
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 3] (3: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] Your spells cost 1 and 1 Rune less, to a minimum of 1.
cards.flavorText: "Prognostication Test 11: Successful, but Tests 14 and 19 will fail. What happens if we skip them?"

cards.name: Clairvoyance
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
[PREDICT 5]. (Look at the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. Recycle any of them and put the rest back in any order.)
Draw 2.

cards.name: Covert Informant
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 3] (3: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] When I move, draw 1.
cards.flavorText: When one person knows, it's a secret. When two know, it's a deal.

cards.name: Patched Porobot
cards.description:
(I enter exhausted.)
When you play me, if you control 3 or more other gear, draw 1.
cards.flavorText: Attempts to synthetically replicate a poro's whimsy and pure adorable nature have yielded mixed results.

cards.name: Shock Blast
cards.description:
[ACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
This costs 2 less if you control something that's [EMPOWERED].
Deal 4 to a unit at a battlefield.
cards.flavorText:
"Feel the thunder!"
—Jayce

cards.name: Sky Cruiser
cards.description: Discard a gear, 1, Exhaust: Deal 4 to a unit at a battlefield.
cards.flavorText: Look out below.

cards.name: Decree of Insight
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
Ignore [DEFLECT] while paying this spell's cost.
Give an enemy Body (Body) unit -5 Might this turn.
cards.flavorText: Force is artless. Be inspired.

cards.name: Hextech Formula
cards.description:
This enters exhausted.
Exhaust: Empower another gear. (It becomes Empowered if it's not already.)
cards.flavorText: Such an innocuous thing.

cards.name: Nasus, Guardian of Knowledge
cards.description: Once each turn, when an enemy unit here dies, channel 1 rune exhausted.
cards.flavorText: "Life is part of a cycle. Yours is over."

cards.name: Nasus, Guardian of Knowledge (Alternate Art)
cards.description: Once each turn, when an enemy unit here dies, channel 1 rune exhausted.
cards.flavorText: "Life is part of a cycle. Yours is over."

cards.name: Plaza Guardian
cards.description:
I cost 1 less for each gear you control.
[DEFLECT] (Opponents must pay Rune to choose me with a spell or ability.)
cards.flavorText: There was uproar at first, but the community learned to ignore it soon enough.

cards.name: Swain, Visionary
cards.description:
[VISION] (When you play me, look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.)
When I conquer, if you've played a non-token unit, a non-token gear, and a spell this turn, you score 1 point.
cards.flavorText: "They are five steps from realizing I am ten steps ahead."

cards.name: Temporal Breach
cards.description:
[HIDDEN] (Hide now for Rune to react with later for 0.)
Banish a unit, then its owner plays it to the same location, ignoring its cost.
cards.flavorText: For the important things, you can always make time.

cards.name: Bottled Constellation
cards.description: At the start of your Main Phase, you may kill 3 other friendly units and/or gear to score 1 point.
cards.flavorText: Infinite possibilities in finite volume.

cards.name: Jayce, Brilliant Inventor
cards.description: When you play me or the first time you play a non-token gear each turn, you may ready something besides me that's exhausted.
cards.flavorText: "I will light our path."

cards.name: Jayce, Brilliant Inventor (Alternate Art)
cards.description: When you play me or the first time you play a non-token gear each turn, you may ready something besides me that's exhausted.
cards.flavorText: "I will light our path."

cards.name: Mel, Newly Awakened
cards.description:
When you play me, draw 1.
[EMPOWER 3] (3: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] Your spells and abilities can't be countered. If a spell or ability you control would give -Might to a unit it chooses, it gives an additional -1 Might.

cards.name: Mel, Newly Awakened (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
When you play me, draw 1.
[EMPOWER 3]
[EMPOWERED] Your spells and abilities can't be countered. If a spell or ability you control would give -Might to a unit it chooses, it gives an additional -1 Might.

cards.name: Brutal Hunter
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 3] (3: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] I have +2 Might and [GANKING]. (I can move from battlefield to battlefield.)
cards.flavorText: Proof of her success was often a mess to sort through.

cards.name: Fretful Feline
cards.description: When I become ready, give me +2 Might this turn.
cards.flavorText: He'd be less eager to escape if he knew what was out there.

cards.name: Guttural Roar
cards.description:
[ACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
Give a unit +2 Might this turn. If it's [EMPOWERED], give it +4 Might this turn instead.
cards.flavorText: The Butcher of the Sands is not known for his patience.

cards.name: Jagged Cutlass
cards.description:
[Equip Body] (Body: Attach this to a unit you control.)
I can't be moved by enemy spells and abilities.
+2 Might

cards.name: Legion Marauder
cards.description:
[EMPOWER] — 1 or Body (Pay either cost: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] I have +1 Might.
cards.flavorText: The Trifarian Legion always has strength in numbers, even when that number is one.

cards.name: Platewyrm Egg
cards.description:
This enters exhausted.
[EMPOWER] — 1, Exhaust (Pay the cost: Empower this. Use only if not Empowered.)
[REACTION] Exhaust: [ADD] 1. If this is [EMPOWERED], [ADD] 2 instead.

cards.name: Repair Specialist
cards.description: I have [ASSAULT] equal to the number of gear you control. (+1 Might while I'm an attacker for each instance of Assault.)
cards.flavorText: What is discarded by Piltover gets a second chance in Zaun.

cards.name: Tools of Empire
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 2] (2: Empower this. Use only if not Empowered.)
Exhaust: Give a unit +2 Might this turn. If this is [EMPOWERED], give that unit +4 Might this turn instead.
cards.flavorText:
"We will unearth what has been lost."
—Azir

cards.name: Baccai Witherclaw
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 1 and 2 Runes] (1 and 2 Runes: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] I have +2 Might.
[EMPOWERED][DEATHKNELL] Channel 2 runes exhausted. (When I die while Empowered, get the effect.)

cards.name: Dame the Despoiler
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 5 and 1 Body] (5 and 1 Body: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] When I attack or defend, choose a unit here. Increase my Might to its Might this turn, then give me +1 Might this turn.
cards.flavorText: "Wanna see a show?!"

cards.name: Noxian Demolitionist
cards.description: When I conquer, you may kill a gear with Energy cost no more than my Might.
cards.flavorText: She lives for the sound, for the wave of heat and pressure, for pushing herself past her limit.

cards.name: Onslaught
cards.description:
Give a unit +6 Might this turn.
[FLOW 4] (You may play this from your trash for its Flow cost. Then banish it.)
cards.flavorText: When hitting them hard isn't enough, try hitting them again.

cards.name: Profiteer
cards.description: When you play me, you may disempower something you control to empower a legend, unit, or gear.
cards.flavorText: "Let's make a deal, shall we?"

cards.name: Rampage
cards.description:
As you play this, you may pay Body as an additional cost.
Choose a friendly unit and an enemy unit. If you paid the additional cost, give the friendly unit +2 Might this turn. They deal damage equal to their Mights to each other.

cards.name: Ambessa, The Wolf
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 3 and 1 Body] (3 and 1 Body: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] I have +3 Might and can't be dealt damage unless I'm in combat.
cards.flavorText: "I will never stumble, never break."

cards.name: Ambessa, The Wolf (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 3 and 1 Body]
[EMPOWERED] I have +3 Might and can't be dealt damage unless I'm in combat.
cards.flavorText: "I will never stumble, never break."

cards.name: Decree of Strength
cards.description: Choose an opponent. They reveal their hand and you choose a Mind (Mind) card from it. They recycle that card.
cards.flavorText: Caution is a labyrinth. Smash through.

cards.name: Gangplank, Naval
cards.description:
[EMPOWER] BodyBody (2 Body: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] If a spell or ability that chooses me would stun me, give me -Might, or return me to hand, give me +3 Might instead.
cards.flavorText: "Death spit me out."

cards.name: Hextech Disc
cards.description:
[EMPOWER] — Exhaust (Pay the cost: Empower this. Use only if not Empowered.)
Disempower this, 1, Exhaust: Play a 3 Might Mech unit token to your base.
cards.flavorText: Excellence at scale.

cards.name: Jayce, Hammer in Hand
cards.description:
When I become ready, choose one to give me this turn ‚Äî
‚Ä¢ [ASSAULT 2] (+2 Might while I'm an attacker.)
‚Ä¢ [DEFLECT 2] (Opponents must pay 2 Runes to choose me with a spell or ability.)
‚Ä¢ [GANKING] (I can move from battlefield to battlefield.)

cards.name: Jayce, Hammer in Hand (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
When I become ready, choose one to give me this turn ‚Äî
‚Ä¢ [ASSAULT 2]
‚Ä¢ [DEFLECT 2]
‚Ä¢ [GANKING]

cards.name: Wild Claw
cards.description: Look at the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. You may banish a unit or gear from among them and play it, reducing its Energy cost by 5. Recycle the rest. Then you may do this: Empower it. (It becomes Empowered if it's not already.)

cards.name: Cataclysmic Duel
cards.description: Each player chooses a unit they control. Kill the rest.

cards.name: Corrupted Dragon
cards.description:
If your score is not within 3 points of the Victory Score, I enter ready.
When I attack, you may move any number of enemy units here each with 5 Might or less to their base.
cards.flavorText: Noble souls fall the furthest.

cards.name: Renekton, Brute
cards.description:
1: Give me +1 Might this turn.
When my Might becomes 10 or more, empower me. (I become Empowered if I'm not already.)
[EMPOWERED] I have [DEFLECT] and [GANKING]. (Opponents must pay Rune to choose me with a spell or ability. I can move from battlefield to battlefield.)

cards.name: Renekton, Brute (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
1: Give me +1 Might this turn.
When my Might becomes 10 or more, empower me.
[EMPOWERED] I have [DEFLECT] and [GANKING].
cards.flavorText: "Embrace the jaws of death."

cards.name: Kinkou Lifeblade
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 2] (2: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] I have +1 Might and [GANKING]. (I can move from battlefield to battlefield.)
cards.flavorText: His life is the blade. His blade is his life.

cards.name: Mask Mother
cards.description: When you discard me, you may pay 1 to give a friendly unit +2 Might this turn.
cards.flavorText: She is mother to all who fall.

cards.name: Shadow Order Disciple
cards.description: When I move, you may [BURN 1] to give me +1 Might this turn. (To Burn 1, put the top card of your Main Deck into your trash.)
cards.flavorText: Recipients of a terrifying education.

cards.name: Shadowblade Lurker
cards.description: I cost 2 less for each card with my name in your trash.
cards.flavorText: You'll never see the second one coming.

cards.name: Spiderling
cards.description:
[HIDDEN] (Hide now for Rune to react with later for 0.)
I have +1 Might for each other unit you control here with my name.
Your deck can have any number of cards named Spiderling.
cards.flavorText: Well, at least there's only one.

cards.name: Stargazer
cards.description: Spells with [FLOW] you play from your trash cost 2 less, to a minimum of 1.
cards.flavorText: "I think that one looks like a dragon!"

cards.name: Tornado Warrior
cards.description:
[HIDDEN] (Hide now for Rune to react with later for 0.)
When you play me from face down, you may empower something here. Disempower it at end of turn.
cards.flavorText: There is a safe spot in every whirlwind, but it's easy enough to hit your enemies with the other parts.

cards.name: Up from the Deep
cards.description:
Play two 1 Might Tentacle unit tokens from Bilgewater.
[FLOW 3] (You may play this from your trash for its Flow cost. Then banish it.)
cards.flavorText:
"The waves will drag you down, unless you fight to shore."
—Illaoi

cards.name: Gust Monk
cards.description:
You may pay 1 as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, banish a card from any trash to give a unit [ASSAULT 2] this turn. (+2 Might while it's an attacker.)
cards.flavorText: An odd technique, but quite effective.

cards.name: Ravenbloom Prefect
cards.description: When an opponent plays a gear, you may banish me to banish it.
cards.flavorText: "Do you have a permit for that?"

cards.name: Shadows of the Past
cards.description: Return up to 2 units from trashes to their owners' hands.
cards.flavorText:
"None escape their shadow."
—Zed

cards.name: Tail-Cloaked Matriarch
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 2 and 1 Chaos] (2 and 1 Chaos: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
When I become [EMPOWERED], you may choose a unit in your trash with Energy cost no more than 3 and Power cost no more than Rune. Play it to your base, ignoring its cost.

cards.name: Twilight Step
cards.description:
Move a unit with 3 Might or less.
[FLOW 4 and 1 Chaos] (You may play this from your trash for its Flow cost. Then banish it.)
cards.flavorText: All motion is deception.

cards.name: Wind and Ghosts
cards.description:
[ACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
Choose a unit at a battlefield. If it has 3 Might or less, banish it. Otherwise, return it to its owner's hand.
cards.flavorText: The best strategy is to not have an enemy.

cards.name: Decree of Discord
cards.description: Return any number of enemy Order (Order) units with total Might 5 or less to their owners' hands.
cards.flavorText: Tradition is a prison. Break free.

cards.name: Forgotten Relic
cards.description: When you play this or at the start of your Beginning Phase, [BURN 1]. When you burn a unit this way, do this: Give a friendly unit +Might equal to the burned card's Might this turn. (To Burn 1, put the top card of your Main Deck into your trash.)

cards.name: Illaoi, Prophet of the Great Kraken
cards.printingName: Illaoi, Prophet of the Great Kraken
cards.description:
When you play me or when I score, play a 1 Might Tentacle unit token from Bilgewater.
I have +1 Might for each token unit you control.
cards.flavorText: "We are not one soul. We are many."

cards.name: Mel, Defiant Soul
cards.description:
[EMPOWER] ‚Äî Discard a spell (Pay the cost: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
When I become [EMPOWERED], banish an enemy unit at a battlefield with 3 Might or less.
cards.flavorText: Medardas are known for our strategy and strength."

cards.name: Mel, Defiant Soul (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
[EMPOWER] ‚Äî Discard a spell
When I become [EMPOWERED], banish an enemy unit at a battlefield with 3 Might or less.
cards.flavorText: Medardas are known for our strategy and strength."

cards.name: Minah Swiftfoot
cards.description:
When I move to a battlefield, choose one —
• Each player discards 1.
• Each player draws 1.
cards.flavorText: She's mastered ten styles of combat, but she's still working on a good catchphrase.

cards.name: Zed, Without a Sound
cards.description:
When I conquer, play a 0 Might Shadow Clone unit token to your base. (It has "When I attack, you may banish a unit from your trash. If you do, give me [ASSAULT 4] this turn.")
[ACTION] 1 and 1 Chaos: Move me and a Shadow Clone you control to each other's locations.

cards.name: Zed, Without a Sound (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
When I conquer, play a 0 Might Shadow Clone unit token to your base.
[ACTION] 1 and 1 Chaos: Move me and a Shadow Clone you control to each other's locations.
cards.flavorText: "The truth lies in darkness."

cards.name: Kennen, Storm of Shuriken
cards.description:
When you play me, [BURN 2]. (Put the top 2 cards of your Main Deck into your trash.)
When I conquer, give a spell in your trash [FLOW] equal to its cost this turn. (You may play it from your trash for its Flow cost. Then banish it.)
cards.flavorText: "Time to strike!"

cards.name: Kennen, Storm of Shuriken (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
When you play me, [BURN 2].
When I conquer, give a spell in your trash [FLOW] equal to its cost this turn.
cards.flavorText: "Time to strike!"

cards.name: Kharox
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 6 and 2 Chaos] (6 and 2 Chaos: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
When I become [EMPOWERED], choose an opponent. They [BURN 3]. Then you may do this: Choose a unit in their trash and play it, ignoring its cost. (To Burn 3, they put the top 3 cards of their Main Deck into their trash.)

cards.name: Ocean Drake
cards.description:
You may play me to an open battlefield.
When you play me, you may return a non-Dragon unit to its owner's hand.
cards.flavorText: The pale glint of blue on blue is all the warning you'll get.

cards.name: Dragon Form
cards.description:
Choose a unit. Its base Might becomes 5 this turn.
[FLOW 3] (You may play this from your trash for its Flow cost. Then banish it.)
cards.flavorText: "The Dragon spirit is not magic. It is life, more ancient than ours." —Lee Sin

cards.name: Disciple of Shen
cards.description:
[HIDDEN] (Hide now for Rune to react with later for 0.)
I have [SHIELD 3] while I'm at a battlefield with exactly one other unit you control. (+3 Might while I'm a defender.)
cards.flavorText: Even twilight itself takes on an apprentice or two.

cards.name: Horns of the Dragon
cards.description: [TANK] (I must be assigned combat damage first.)
cards.flavorText: Don't mess with them. You know what you'll get.

cards.name: Keeper of Law
cards.description: I cost 2 and 1 Order less if you control a battlefield with exactly two units there.
cards.flavorText: Order will be preserved. Unity will be maintained.

cards.name: Masa, Crashing Thunder
cards.description:
You may pay Order as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, [STUN] an enemy unit at a battlefield. (It doesn't deal combat damage this turn.)
cards.flavorText: He's louder than he looks, which is saying quite a bit.

cards.name: Reluctant Leader
cards.description: When you play another unit, give me +2 Might this turn.
cards.flavorText: Sometimes there's no one else who will do the job.

cards.name: Solari Sunhawk
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 2] (2: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] I have +1 Might and [DEFLECT 2]. (Opponents must pay 2 Runes to choose me with a spell or ability.)
cards.flavorText: At its cry, the dawn breaks.

cards.name: Soulspinner
cards.description: [AMBUSH] (You may play me as a [REACTION] to a battlefield where you have units.)
cards.flavorText: There are worse fates than being eaten.

cards.name: Escaped Grayback
cards.description:
[EMPOWER] — Kill a friendly unit (Pay the cost: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] I have +2 Might.
cards.flavorText: "Strength comes from the will to be free."

cards.name: Hungry Wolf
cards.description: Order: Ready me and give me +1 Might this turn. Use only if you've chosen an enemy unit this turn and only once each turn.
cards.flavorText:
"A wolf has no mercy."
—Ambessa

cards.name: Ki Barrier
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
Choose a unit. Prevent the next 7 damage that would be dealt to it this turn. (Opponents can assign it extra combat damage to kill it.)

cards.name: Lacerate
cards.description:
Choose a unit. If it's [EMPOWERED], disempower it. Then kill it if it has 3 Might or less.
[FLOW 4 and 2 Order] (You may play this from your trash for its Flow cost. Then banish it.)
cards.flavorText:
"Look at you. Such wasted potential."
—Ambessa

cards.name: Noxian Emissary
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 1 and 1 Order] (1 and 1 Order: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED][DEATHKNELL] Play two 1 Might Recruit unit tokens to your base. (When I die while Empowered, get the effect.)
cards.flavorText: He speaks with the full might of Noxus behind him.

cards.name: Sacred Protector
cards.description: I don't deal combat damage unless I'm at a battlefield with exactly one other unit you control.
cards.flavorText: It is single-mindedly dedicated to its charge.

cards.name: Aurok General
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 3 and 1 Order] (3 and 1 Order: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] Your units that are [EMPOWERED] have +2 Might (including me).
cards.flavorText: "Heed my command."

cards.name: Decree of Unity
cards.description: Kill an enemy Chaos (Chaos) unit or gear.
cards.flavorText: Disorder is isolation. Reach out.

cards.name: Fallen Feline
cards.description:
When you play me, name a spell.
While I'm at a battlefield, opponents can't play spells with that name.
cards.flavorText: Cat got your tongue?

cards.name: Glowstone
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 2 Runes] (2 Runes: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
Disempower this, Exhaust: Choose a player. They gain control of this and recall it. (Send it to their base.)
At the end of your turn, kill this and deal 5 to all units you control.

cards.name: Kayle, Justified
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 3] (3: Empower me.)
